_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Iran covering Elamite civilisation, Achaemenid Empire (Cyrus the Great, Persepolis), Seleucid and Parthian periods, Sassanid Empire, Arab/Islamic conquest, Samanid and Buyid renaissance, Seljuk Turks, Mongol/Ilkhanid destruction, Timurid era, Safavid Empire (Shia state religion), Afsharid/Zand, Qajar dynasty, Constitutional Revolution 1906, Pahlavi dynasty (Reza Shah, Mohammad Reza), 1953 CIA coup, White Revolution, 1979 Islamic Revolution, Iran-Iraq War, and Islamic Republic.

religion.note: Shia Islam is state religion since Safavid era (1501); Baha'i faith persecuted though largest non-Muslim minority; growing irreligion especially among youth

ethnic_groups.name: Persian
ethnic_groups.notes: Iranian (Indo-European); Farsi-speaking; central plateau, Tehran, Isfahan, Shiraz; historically ruling elite; Persian literature (Ferdowsi, Hafez, Rumi, Saadi)

ethnic_groups.name: Azerbaijani (Azeri)
ethnic_groups.notes: Turkic; northwestern Iran (East/West Azerbaijan, Zanjan, Ardabil); Shia; largest minority; Supreme Leader Khamenei is of Azeri origin; estimated 15-20M

ethnic_groups.name: Kurdish
ethnic_groups.notes: Iranian (Northwestern); Kurdistan, Kermanshah, Ilam provinces; mostly Sunni; KDPI and PJAK movements; Mahabad Republic 1946; cross-border with Iraq/Türkiye

ethnic_groups.name: Lur
ethnic_groups.notes: Iranian; Lorestan, Kohgiluyeh, Bakhtiari; closely related to Persian; tribal; Bakhtiari sub-group historically powerful

ethnic_groups.name: Baloch
ethnic_groups.notes: Iranian (Northwestern); Sistan-Baluchestan; Sunni; cross-border with Pakistan/Afghanistan; Jundallah/separatist activity; least developed province

ethnic_groups.name: Arab
ethnic_groups.notes: Khuzestan province; Arabic-speaking; Shia; oil-rich region; Ahwazi Arab identity movement

ethnic_groups.name: Turkmen
ethnic_groups.notes: Northeastern (Golestan); Turkic; Sunni; cross-border with Turkmenistan; horse breeding (Akhal-Teke)

ethnic_groups.name: Gilaki
ethnic_groups.notes: Gilan province; Iranian (Caspian); Caspian coast; rice farming; distinct culture; Jangal Movement 1917-1921

ethnic_groups.name: Mazandarani
ethnic_groups.notes: Mazandaran province; Iranian (Caspian); Caspian coast; Tabari language; forested; distinct from Persian

ethnic_groups.name: Other (Qashqai, Talysh, Tat, Armenian, Assyrian, Georgian, Jewish, Hazara)
ethnic_groups.notes: Qashqai (Turkic nomads, Fars); Talysh (Iranian, Gilan); Armenian community (Isfahan/Julfa); Assyrian Christians; small Georgian community; Iranian Jews (~8,500, largest Jewish community in Middle East outside Israel); Afghan Hazara refugees (~3M Afghans in Iran)

independence.notes: Continuous Persian civilisation ~2,500 years; Islamic Republic established 1979-04-01

geography.terrain: Central plateau surrounded by mountains (Zagros west, Alborz north); deserts (Dasht-e Kavir, Dasht-e Lut); Caspian coast; Persian Gulf coast
geography.notes: 18th largest country; Dasht-e Lut hottest recorded surface temperature (70.7°C); Lake Urmia ecological disaster (lost 80% volume); Strait of Hormuz controls 20% of world oil; seismically active (Bam 2003 earthquake, 30,000 killed).

economy_extended.notes: Crippled by US/EU sanctions (re-imposed 2018); world's 3rd/4th largest oil reserves; 2nd largest gas reserves; 'resistance economy' policy; massive brain drain; rial lost 90%+ value since 2015; IRGC controls 30%+ of economy.

health.notes: Advanced healthcare for region; sanctions impact medicine/equipment imports; COVIran Barekat locally developed COVID vaccine; road traffic deaths among world's highest; thalassemia screening programme; medical tourism (nose jobs capital of world).

food_agriculture.notes: World's #1 saffron producer (90%+ global share); #1 pistachio producer; pomegranate and date exports significant; water crisis threatening agriculture (aquifer depletion); qanat irrigation systems (UNESCO heritage).

energy.notes: World's 4th largest oil reserves, 2nd largest gas reserves (South Pars/North Dome); Bushehr nuclear plant; JCPOA nuclear deal collapsed; sanctions limit oil exports; massive gas flaring; energy subsidies consume 12%+ GDP.

transport.notes: Sanctions impact aviation (aged fleet, safety concerns); rail network being expanded; Chabahar Port (India-funded, bypasses Pakistan); INSTC (International North-South Transport Corridor); world's highest road fatality rate.

tourism.notes: 27 UNESCO World Heritage Sites (10th most globally); enormous potential limited by sanctions, visa restrictions, mandatory hijab; Persian hospitality renowned; 7,000+ year civilisational heritage; medical/health tourism growing.

legal_system.notes: Velayat-e faqih (guardianship of the jurist) system; Guardian Council vets all candidates; Supreme Leader above all; second highest executions globally (after China); morality police; Mahsa Amini protests 2022.

human_rights_gender.notes: Mahsa Amini protests (2022) — 'Woman, Life, Freedom' movement; mandatory hijab enforcement; LGBTQ+ executions; massive internet shutdowns; political prisoners; journalist/activist detentions; theocratic control of all aspects of life.

security_stability.notes: Regional power projection (proxy forces in Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Yemen — 'Axis of Resistance'); IRGC-Quds Force; nuclear programme (JCPOA collapsed); US-Iran tensions; Kurdish insurgency (PJAK); Baloch insurgency; Israel-Iran shadow war.

cultural_heritage.notes: Persian Empire (550 BCE) one of history's largest; Persian language literary tradition (Shahnameh, Hafez, Rumi); Zoroastrianism originated here; Persian gardens (UNESCO); cinema internationally acclaimed despite censorship.

comparative_rankings.notes: Enormous potential undermined by sanctions, isolation, and theocratic governance; high HDI for region despite sanctions; brain drain massive (highest globally); cultural/civilisational soft power significant.
comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global. 'rank' = 1 is best/largest.

current_leader.name: Ali Khamenei
current_leader.title: Supreme Leader
current_leader.notes: Highest authority; Azeri origin; succeeded Khomeini; controls military (IRGC), judiciary, media; hardliner; nuclear programme; 'Woman, Life, Freedom' crackdown 2022

president.name: Masoud Pezeshkian
president.title: President
president.notes: Reformist; cardiothoracic surgeon; Azeri-Kurdish; elected after Raisi's death in helicopter crash May 2024

former_leaders.name: Ruhollah Khomeini
former_leaders.notes: Founder of Islamic Republic; Grand Ayatollah; led 1979 revolution; Supreme Leader; velayat-e faqih (guardianship of jurist); Iran-Iraq War; fatwa against Salman Rushdie; died June 1989

former_leaders.name: Mohammad Reza Pahlavi
former_leaders.notes: Last Shah; Pahlavi dynasty; 1953 CIA-MI6 coup restored him; White Revolution (modernisation); SAVAK secret police; fled January 1979; died in exile Egypt 1980

former_leaders.name: Reza Shah Pahlavi
former_leaders.notes: Founded Pahlavi dynasty; modernisation; forced abdication by Anglo-Soviet invasion 1941

former_leaders.name: Mohammad Mosaddegh
former_leaders.notes: Nationalised oil (Anglo-Iranian Oil Company); overthrown by CIA/MI6 coup (Operation Ajax); died under house arrest 1967

former_leaders.name: Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani
former_leaders.notes: Pragmatic conservative; post-war reconstruction; economic liberalisation; died 2017

former_leaders.name: Mohammad Khatami
former_leaders.notes: Reformist; 'Dialogue Among Civilizations'; student movement; blocked by hardliners

former_leaders.name: Mahmoud Ahmadinejad
former_leaders.notes: Hardline populist; Holocaust denial; nuclear standoff; 2009 Green Movement (disputed election)

former_leaders.name: Ebrahim Raisi
former_leaders.notes: Hardliner; judiciary chief; linked to 1988 political executions; died in helicopter crash May 2024
